WITH region AS (
  SELECT ST_GeomFromText('POLYGON ((-100.191844 40.001658, -100.196465 40.350086, -100.311089 40.349854, -100.327988 40.351173, -100.419678 40.350449, -100.553001 40.350388, -100.652534 40.349911, -100.662186 40.349861, -100.703812 40.349636, -100.70623 40.349625, -100.71949 40.349094, -100.756889 40.348877, -100.756854 40.002214, -100.739866 40.002172, -100.645205 40.001914, -100.566525 40.001926, -100.519014 40.001851, -100.477509 40.001843, -100.346168 40.001778, -100.271564 40.001705, -100.191844 40.001658))', 4326) AS g
),
buffered_region AS (
  SELECT
    g,
    ST_Buffer(g::geography, 100)::geometry AS g_buffer
  FROM region
),
clipped_dem AS (
  SELECT ST_Union(ST_Clip(d.rast, r.g_buffer)) AS rast
  FROM public.dem_us d
  JOIN buffered_region r
    ON ST_Intersects(d.rast, r.g_buffer)
),
slope AS (
  SELECT ST_Slope(rast, 1, '32BF', 'DEGREES', 111120) AS rast
  FROM clipped_dem
),
region_slope AS (
  SELECT ST_Clip(s.rast, r.g) AS rast
  FROM slope s, buffered_region r
)
SELECT (ST_SummaryStats(rast, 1, TRUE)).min AS slope
FROM region_slope;

  SELECT geometry::geometry AS geom
  FROM regions
  WHERE region_name ILIKE 'Red Willow County' AND border_type = 'county'
),
flattest_area AS (
  SELECT
    ST_Clip(
      r.rast,
      (SELECT geom FROM red_willow_county),
      TRUE
    ) AS clipped_rast
  FROM public.dem_us r
  WHERE ST_Intersects(
    r.rast,
    (SELECT geom FROM red_willow_county)
  )
),
slope_raster AS (
  SELECT
    ST_Slope(clipped_rast, 1, '32BF') AS slope_rast
),
flattest_value AS (
  SELECT
    MIN(ST_Value(slope_rast, 1)) AS min_slope
  FROM slope_raster
)
SELECT
  min_slope AS flattest_slope_degrees
FROM flattest_value;
